<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const source = document.querySelector(".member-range-source");
  const modified = document.querySelector(".quarto-title-meta .date-modified");
  if (source && modified) {
    const range = source.dataset.memberRange || modified.textContent;
    const contents = modified.closest(".quarto-title-meta-contents");
    const heading = contents ? contents.previousElementSibling : null;
    if (heading && heading.classList.contains("quarto-title-meta-heading")) {
      heading.textContent = `Member from ${range}`;
      if (contents) { contents.remove(); }
    } else {
      modified.textContent = range;
    }
  }
});
</script>
